applicationInfo.name: Threat Model Export
applicationInfo.description: Oncology Semantic Hub - an open-source (MIT-0) AWS solution accelerator that unifies cancer genomics (TCGA, cBioPortal), curated biomedical knowledge (PrimeKG), variant annotations (CIViC, ClinVar) and literature into a governed semantic layer queried by an agentic AI application. Accelerator 1 is a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime (Claude Sonnet 4.5) with env-gated tool tiers L0-L3 (Neptune knowledge-graph queries, Athena patient-data/variant SQL, Bedrock Knowledge Base retrieval, OLS ontology lookup via remote MCP, AWS-managed web search). Accelerator 2 is an agentic dataset-onboarding pipeline (Streamlit + LLM curation agent) that discovers AWS Registry of Open Data (RODA) datasets via a live MCP client, LLM-curates column-to-hub mappings, generates declarative transform specs, and executes ETL inside an AgentCore Code Interpreter sandbox to write additive *_staging tables. Data plane: Neptune Analytics, Athena/Glue/S3 (Lake Formation governed), Bedrock Knowledge Base. Shipped demo uses PUBLIC de-identified TCGA data (no PHI); a documented Bring-Your-Own-Data path lets customers substitute their own cohort, which may be PHI. Explicitly demonstrative - not for clinical use or production per the repo legal note.

assumptions.content: The shipped/demo deployment uses only PUBLIC de-identified TCGA data (no PHI). HIPAA is latent, triggered only by the documented Bring-Your-Own-Data path where a customer substitutes their own (possibly PHI) cohort.

Authentication is a single shared Cognito M2M (client_credentials) JWT; the client secret is in SSM as a plaintext String; no per-user identity or per-user data scoping; one IAM execution role runs all queries.
AgentCore Runtimes (agent + MCP servers + Code Interpreter) are deployed with networkMode PUBLIC and must ship with the CUSTOM_JWT authorizer.
The IAM execution role policy grants actions on Resource:"*" rather than resource-scoped ARNs.

Read-only enforcement relies on least-privilege IAM plus in-process guards (hub_core/guards.py). The onboarding text-to-SQL path uses a separate regex/allowlist guard in agent.py, not hub_core.guards.

Data onboarding is human-in-the-loop and writes only additive *_staging tables; ETL runs the fixed dynamic.py harness (LLM emits only a declarative spec, not code) inside an AgentCore Code Interpreter sandbox.
Python dependencies are declared unpinned in requirements.txt; the RODA MCP client runs as a uvx-spawned subprocess of awslabs.roda-mcp-server.

AWS Security Hub control BedrockAgentCore.1 states AgentCore runtimes should be configured with VPC network mode, and the AWS AI security standard requires the AgentCore Code Interpreter to use a private network configuration. This system deploys runtimes and the Code Interpreter with networkMode PUBLIC.

Risk-acceptance basis: threats were Accepted only where an implemented control (read-only guards+tests, guarded onboarding SQL, fixed ETL harness+HITL, provenance-faithfulness scorer, single-tenant demo) reduces them to Low/Medium AND the shipped data is public TCGA. All Confidentiality/Integrity risks that depend on unbuilt controls (Guardrails, per-user auth/scoping, secret hardening, IAM scoping, cost caps, dep pinning, faithfulness-toggle gating, BYOD hardening) were left Open as must-fix before production or BYOD/PHI use.

mitigations.content: Multi-layer input validation + Amazon Bedrock Guardrails for prompt-injection defense across every agent input surface (user prompt AND tool/retrieved content).

Treat all tool outputs / retrieved passages as untrusted data: structurally delimit and label external content in the context, never execute embedded instructions, and keep the existing inline-provenance/citation discipline.
Store the Cognito client secret in SSM SecureString (KMS) or Secrets Manager and scope ssm:GetParameter to the exact parameter ARNs; enable rotation.
Replace the shared M2M identity with per-user SSO/OIDC (authorization_code) so each caller presents their own short-lived JWT (sub/email/groups).
Enforce the CUSTOM_JWT authorizer on every PUBLIC AgentCore endpoint with a deploy-time preflight that fails if the authorizer is absent, and migrate runtimes to VPC network mode.
Per-user/tenant data authorization: sts:AssumeRole with session name/tags = user, plus Lake Formation grants scoped per group; restrict cohorts/tables by the caller's claims.
Keep the in-process read-only guards (reject_mutations / require_select) AND explicitly deny all write actions in IAM as the authoritative backstop; unit-test guards against a bypass corpus.
Harden the onboarding text-to-SQL path: reuse hub_core.guards.require_select, validate/parameterize identifiers, keep the table allowlist + mandatory LIMIT.

Keep the fixed dynamic.py ETL harness + validate_spec (LLM emits only a validated declarative spec) and run the Code Interpreter with a private/VPC network configuration and tightly-scoped egress + role.
Bound query cost/complexity: Athena workgroup per-query data-scan limits + result caps, and Neptune query timeouts / row limits.
Cap agent autonomy and spend: max tool-call iterations per turn, max tokens, loop detection, and CloudWatch cost/anomaly alarms (denial-of-wallet).
Enforce session isolation: bind _SESSIONS entries to the authenticated principal, use unguessable session ids, and apply TTL/eviction so warm containers cannot leak context across users.
Observability data hygiene: redact prompts/answers/PHI from traces/logs, encrypt log groups with KMS, and least-privilege access to CloudWatch/X-Ray.
Scope the IAM execution role to specific resource ARNs and split per function (agent vs onboarding vs MCP), removing Resource:*.
Software supply-chain hardening: pin dependencies with hashes, vendor/lock the RODA MCP server version, and run SCA/dependency scanning in CI.
Faithfulness assurance: remove/production-gate the SEMHUB_STRIP_GUARDS toggle, and run the provenance-faithfulness / grounding scorer with alerting on fabricated grounding.
Availability assurance for the data plane: make Lake Formation grants explicit + verified post-deploy and alarm on query failures / graph unavailability.
BYOD/HIPAA hardening profile: gate PHI onboarding behind a hardened configuration (BAA, VPC network mode, per-user scoping, KMS encryption, audit, log redaction) with explicit documentation.
Edge protection on public endpoints: AWS WAF + rate limiting / throttling in front of the agent and MCP endpoints.

components.name: Semantic Hub Agent (AgentCore Runtime)
components.description: Single-file Strands agent (semantic_hub_agent.py), env-gated tool tiers L0-L3. Entry point invoke(); reuses per-session Agent objects in an in-memory _SESSIONS dict in the warm container. networkMode PUBLIC.

components.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Bedrock model)
components.description: Foundation model backing the agent and the onboarding curation/NL/text-to-SQL calls. temperature 0.0.

components.name: OLS MCP Server (remote)
components.description: Remote EBI Ontology Lookup Service MCP server; separate component. CUSTOM_JWT (Cognito M2M) authorizer. Agent calls search_terms over streamable-http with Bearer token.

components.name: oncology-hub-data MCP Server (planned)
components.description: Planned remote MCP server exposing 4 read-only tools (graph/lake/variant/schema) over HTTPS+JWT, reusing OLS Cognito. In-process read-only guards. networkMode PUBLIC.

components.name: AWS-managed Web Search (AgentCore Gateway)
components.description: L0-web tool: web_search calls the AWS-managed Web Search Tool via AgentCore Gateway (us-east-1) using an OAuth client-credentials token. Returns untrusted web content into the LLM context.

components.name: Cognito User Pool (M2M auth)
components.description: Machine-to-machine OAuth2 client_credentials pool (shared with OLS). Issues short-lived JWTs validated by the CUSTOM_JWT authorizer. Single shared app-client; no per-user identity.

components.name: SSM Parameter Store
components.description: Holds OLS/data MCP config + Cognito client_id/secret and KB id. Secret stored as plaintext String (not SecureString) per current-state design.

components.name: Dataset Onboarding UI (Streamlit)
components.description: 5-stage onboarding UI (discover->align->plan->execute->wire). Human-in-the-loop review of LLM-curated mappings and transform specs before apply.

components.name: Onboarding Curation Agent (orchestration)
components.description: LLM-backed: curate_mapping (columns->hub constructs), generate_transform_spec (declarative), nl_answer, and guarded text-to-SQL (answer_question/answer_hub: SELECT-only + write-keyword reject + table allowlist + LIMIT). Ingests untrusted RODA samples.

components.name: AgentCore Code Interpreter sandbox
components.description: Runs the FIXED dynamic.py ETL harness (LLM supplies only a validated declarative spec, not code). Scoped role agentcore-onboarding-ci-role. networkMode PUBLIC. Reads arbitrary public RODA S3, writes additive *_staging Parquet + Glue tables.

components.name: RODA MCP client (uvx subprocess)
components.description: Live discovery client spawned as a uvx subprocess; searches the AWS Registry of Open Data (search_datasets/preview_dataset/sample_dataset). Returns untrusted third-party dataset metadata/content.

components.name: Athena query engine
components.description: Executes read-only SQL (SELECT/WITH/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN) against the Lake Formation-governed lake databases; results to an S3 athena-results prefix.

components.name: Glue Data Catalog + Lake Formation
components.specific_service: AWS Glue Data Catalog + Lake Formation
components.description: Table metadata + fine-grained governance. Runtime role granted DESCRIBE/SELECT via best-effort Lake Formation grants at deploy time.

components.name: Observability (CloudWatch/X-Ray)
components.description: OpenTelemetry traces/spans, EMF/PutMetricData grounding metrics, agent logs. Prompts and answers may appear in traces/logs.

connections.description: Agent invokes Claude Sonnet 4.5 (streaming) for reasoning + tool selection.
query_patient_data / query_variant_annotation / query_primekg -> Athena (SQL passes require_select guard).
Athena reads TCGA patient lake (Lake Formation governed).
Athena reads RODA/staging DB.
Athena reads raw flat PrimeKG (L2).
Athena writes query results to the athena-results S3 prefix.
query_knowledge_graph -> Neptune openCypher (read; passes reject_mutations guard).
knowledge_search -> Bedrock Knowledge Base retrieve; passages returned into LLM context.
Agent reads SSM params (OLS/KB config + Cognito client_id/secret).
Agent mints a Cognito M2M JWT (client_credentials) to call the OLS MCP server.
ontology_lookup -> OLS MCP server (streamable-http, Bearer JWT); returns external content into LLM context.
web_search -> AWS-managed Web Search via AgentCore Gateway (L0-web); untrusted web content into LLM context.
get_hub_schema live introspection: Glue GetDatabases/GetTables + Neptune GetGraphSummary.
OTel traces/spans + EMF/PutMetricData grounding metrics; prompts/answers may appear in logs/traces.
OLS MCP server validates the inbound JWT against the Cognito issuer (CUSTOM_JWT authorizer).
Planned data MCP server: query_knowledge_graph -> Neptune (read-only guarded).
Planned data MCP server: query_patient_data/variant -> Athena (read-only guarded).
Streamlit UI drives the onboarding curation agent through the 5 stages (HITL review).
Curation agent calls Bedrock Converse for mapping, transform-spec generation, NL answers, text-to-SQL.
Onboarding discovery via the live RODA MCP client (uvx stdio subprocess).
RODA MCP client searches/previews/samples third-party public open-data S3 buckets (anonymous).
Curation agent invokes the Code Interpreter sandbox to run the fixed ETL harness (executeCode).
ETL sandbox reads source data from arbitrary public RODA S3 buckets (UNSIGNED/anonymous).
ETL sandbox writes additive *_staging Parquet to S3 and registers Glue tables (additive only).
ETL sandbox creates/replaces Glue tables for the new staging dataset.
Onboarding text-to-SQL (answer_question/answer_hub) runs generated SELECTs against staging via Athena.
onboard_runner.ask_l3 invokes the live deployed L3 agent runtime to answer over the augmented hub.

dataStores.name: Neptune Analytics knowledge graph
dataStores.description: Neptune Analytics graph: PrimeKG relationships + TCGA case/sample nodes (clinical properties). Read via openCypher. BYOD could load enterprise KG.

dataStores.name: TCGA patient data lake (S3/Athena oncology_semantic_hub)
dataStores.description: TCGA patient data lake (Parquet on S3, database oncology_semantic_hub): tcga_mutations/expression/copy-number. Lake Formation governed. BYOD may hold PHI.

dataStores.name: RODA/staging DB (S3/Athena oncology_semantic_hub_roda)
dataStores.description: RODA variant-annotation + onboarded additive *_staging tables (database oncology_semantic_hub_roda) on S3. Written by the onboarding ETL sandbox.

dataStores.name: Raw flat PrimeKG DB (S3/Athena oncology_semantic_hub_raw)
dataStores.description: Flat PrimeKG for the L2 baseline (database oncology_semantic_hub_raw) on S3.

dataStores.name: Bedrock Knowledge Base vector store
dataStores.description: Bedrock Knowledge Base vector store over PubMed abstracts + TCGA study descriptions. Passages retrieved into LLM context (knowledge_search).

dataStores.name: External RODA public S3 buckets
dataStores.description: Third-party public S3 buckets on the AWS Registry of Open Data (e.g. civic-aws-opendata, genoxus-annotation-release) read anonymously (UNSIGNED) by the ETL sandbox. Untrusted external source.

dataStores.name: Athena query-results S3 prefix
dataStores.description: S3 athena-results/ prefix holding query outputs (read/write by the runtime role).

threatActors.name: Insider
threatActors.description: Deployer/operator/data-engineer with legitimate broad AWS access to Bedrock/Neptune/Athena/Glue/SSM and the onboarding pipeline.

threatActors.name: External Attacker
threatActors.description: External individual/group reaching the PUBLIC AgentCore endpoints; primary conventional external threat given networkMode PUBLIC + shared M2M auth.

threatActors.name: Nation-state Actor
threatActors.description: Genomics/health research can draw state espionage interest, but low likelihood against the public-data demo; relevant mainly for BYOD production.

threatActors.name: Hacktivist
threatActors.description: Healthcare is a sector-focused hacktivist target; could aim to discredit or deface a research tool.

threatActors.name: Organized Crime
threatActors.description: Financially motivated; low value against public TCGA, but material for BYOD/PHI production deployments (exfiltration/ransomware of a patient cohort).

threatActors.name: Competitor
threatActors.description: Low: data is public and the value proposition is a methodology; limited IP to steal in the shipped demo.

threatActors.name: Script Kiddie
threatActors.description: Opportunistic scanning of the internet-exposed AgentCore endpoints; low sophistication but relevant due to PUBLIC exposure.

threatActors.name: Disgruntled Employee
threatActors.description: Former deployer/operator retaining knowledge of the shared M2M secret / SSM params or role access.

threatActors.name: Privileged User
threatActors.description: The single elevated IAM execution role (Resource:*) and deployer credentials; abuse or error has broad blast radius with no per-user scoping.

threatActors.name: Third Party
threatActors.description: Supply-chain / third-party surface: unpinned deps, uvx-spawned awslabs.roda-mcp-server, external OLS/web-search/RODA services whose content and availability the agents depend on.

threatActors.name: Terrorist Organization
threatActors.description: Not relevant: no critical-infrastructure or destructive target profile for a public-data research accelerator.

threatActors.type: Private Sector Offensive Actor / Cyber Mercenary
threatActors.name: Private Sector Offensive Actor
threatActors.description: Not relevant to the shipped public-data demo; mercenary zero-day operations are disproportionate to the target value.

threatActors.name: Adversarial open-data / content author (indirect prompt injection)
threatActors.description: An actor who plants indirect prompt-injection payloads or poisoned/misleading records in content the agents ingest: AWS Registry of Open Data datasets (discovered/sampled by the onboarding agent), the PubMed/TCGA Knowledge Base corpus, web-search results, or OLS responses. Goal: manipulate the LLM to fabricate oncology findings/citations, exfiltrate data, misroute tool calls, or steer the onboarding curation/text-to-SQL. Distinctive top actor for this agentic system.

threatActors.name: Malicious hub user (prompt injection / jailbreak / tool abuse)
threatActors.description: A user (authenticated researcher or, given PUBLIC endpoints, an anonymous internet actor) who crafts adversarial prompts to jailbreak the agent, exfiltrate data beyond entitlement, abuse the query tools (resource-exhaustion Cypher/SQL, attempts to bypass the read-only guards), or coerce confident fabricated medical claims that undermine the faithfulness guarantee.

trustZones.name: External / Untrusted (internet, third-party content & services)
trustZones.description: Internet-facing untrusted zone: anonymous/authenticated external clients reaching the PUBLIC AgentCore endpoints, plus third-party content/services whose output is treated as untrusted (OLS MCP, AWS web search, RODA MCP client, external RODA public S3 buckets).

trustZones.name: Agent / LLM Execution (AgentCore Runtime)
trustZones.description: The LLM/agent execution zone on Bedrock AgentCore: the semantic hub agent, the Bedrock model, the planned data MCP server, the onboarding curation agent, and the Code Interpreter ETL sandbox. Low trust because it processes untrusted prompts and untrusted tool/data outputs and its decisions must not be implicitly trusted.

trustZones.name: Operator / Deployment
trustZones.description: Operator/deployer workstation running the Streamlit onboarding UI and deploy scripts; holds elevated AWS credentials and performs human-in-the-loop approvals.

trustZones.name: Identity & Secrets
trustZones.description: Identity and secrets services: Cognito M2M user pool and SSM Parameter Store (holds the shared client secret + config).

trustZones.name: Governed Data Plane (AWS account)
trustZones.description: Governed AWS data plane inside the account: Athena, Glue Data Catalog + Lake Formation, Neptune Analytics graph, S3 lake databases (TCGA/RODA/raw/results), Bedrock Knowledge Base, and observability. Highest trust; protected by IAM + Lake Formation + read-only guards.

crossingPoints.description: Inbound to the PUBLIC AgentCore agent/MCP endpoints and outbound agent->OLS/web-search. Cognito M2M JWT validated by CUSTOM_JWT authorizer (allowedClients). Untrusted external content crosses into the LLM context here (prompt-injection surface).
Agent/onboarding + Code Interpreter sandbox read third-party open data from RODA public S3 anonymously (UNSIGNED). No auth; content fully untrusted and flows into LLM curation and the ETL sandbox.

Agent/MCP/sandbox -> governed data plane (Neptune, Athena, Glue/LF, KB, S3, observability). Enforced by the single IAM execution role (Resource:*), Lake Formation grants, and in-process read-only guards (reject_mutations / require_select) + onboarding text-to-SQL guard. Critical control boundary.
Agent -> Identity & Secrets: SSM GetParameter for OLS/KB config + Cognito client_id/secret (secret stored as plaintext String), and Cognito token minting.
Operator workstation drives the onboarding curation agent (HITL approvals) and deploys runtimes; broad AWS credentials.
OLS MCP server validates the inbound Cognito M2M JWT against the shared user pool (CUSTOM_JWT authorizer). Auth depends entirely on the shared client secret.

trustBoundaries.name: Internet / Untrusted-Content Boundary
controls: networkMode PUBLIC (AWS recommends VPC per BedrockAgentCore.1)
No dedicated prompt-injection / content-sanitization filter on tool outputs
trustBoundaries.description: Network + content boundary between the internet/third-party content and the agent/LLM zone. Governs inbound API access (JWT) and the flow of untrusted external content (OLS, web search, RODA open data) into the LLM context and ETL sandbox.

trustBoundaries.name: Agent-to-Data-Plane Boundary
controls: Onboarding text-to-SQL guard (SELECT-only, write-keyword reject, table allowlist, LIMIT)
Additive *_staging writes only; prod tables untouched
trustBoundaries.description: The critical control boundary between the low-trust agent zone and the governed data plane. Read-only enforcement, IAM, and Lake Formation are the primary defenses against excessive agency and data exfiltration. No per-user data scoping (single role).

trustBoundaries.name: Identity & Secrets Boundary
controls: Client secret stored as plaintext String (not SecureString)
trustBoundaries.description: Boundary to identity/secrets. Weakness: the shared Cognito M2M secret is stored in SSM as plaintext; anyone with ssm:GetParameter can mint valid tokens (per per-user-auth-design.md).

trustBoundaries.name: Operator / Onboarding-Autonomy Boundary
controls: Human-in-the-loop review of LLM-curated mappings and transform specs
Fixed dynamic.py ETL harness (validates declarative spec; no LLM-authored AWS I/O)
Code Interpreter sandbox isolation (networkMode PUBLIC; AWS recommends private)
trustBoundaries.description: Process/account boundary between the operator zone and the agentic onboarding pipeline. HITL approval and the fixed harness bound the onboarding agent's autonomy; sandbox isolation contains ETL execution.

assets.name: TCGA patient cohort data
assets.description: De-identified public TCGA mutations/expression/CNA queried read-only from the lake. Integrity/availability matter more than confidentiality for the demo; confidentiality escalates under BYOD.

assets.name: Neptune knowledge-graph facts
assets.description: PrimeKG + TCGA case/sample knowledge graph facts returned by query_knowledge_graph. Integrity is central to grounded answers.

assets.name: Knowledge Base literature passages
assets.description: PubMed/TCGA literature passages retrieved from the Bedrock KB into the LLM context. If poisoned, drives fabricated citations.

assets.name: Cognito M2M client secret
assets.description: Shared Cognito M2M OAuth client_id/secret in SSM (plaintext String). Disclosure lets any holder mint valid JWTs for the MCP endpoints.

assets.name: Cognito M2M access token (JWT)
assets.description: Short-lived Cognito M2M access token (Bearer JWT, ~60 min) presented to OLS/data MCP endpoints.

assets.name: Untrusted external content (RODA/web/OLS)
assets.description: Untrusted third-party content ingested into the LLM/ETL: RODA dataset schemas/samples/content, web-search results, OLS responses, KB passages. Primary indirect-prompt-injection / data-poisoning carrier.

assets.name: Agent answer + provenance tags
assets.description: Agent's natural-language answer with inline provenance tags and grounding/faithfulness metrics. Integrity (no fabricated citations) is the core value proposition.

assets.name: BYOD customer PHI cohort (latent)
assets.description: Latent: customer PHI cohort substituted for TCGA via the BYOD path. Not in the shipped demo; drives HIPAA obligations and elevates all confidentiality flows when present.

flows.description: Code Interpreter sandbox reads untrusted third-party open data from RODA public S3 anonymously; content is parsed and (samples) fed to the LLM. No authentication, no content trust.
RODA MCP client returns dataset metadata/samples to the onboarding curation agent (LLM), which curates mappings and generates transform specs. Indirect prompt-injection carrier.
OLS ontology-lookup responses and (L0-web) web-search results flow into the agent's LLM context. Bearer-JWT authenticated to the endpoint but the returned content is untrusted (injection surface).
Bedrock KB literature passages retrieved into the LLM context (knowledge_search). Drives citations; poisoned corpus => fabricated PMIDs.
TCGA lake query results reach the agent via Athena. Protected by IAM, Lake Formation, and the require_select read-only guard.
Neptune openCypher results to the agent; reject_mutations guard enforces read-only.
Agent reads the shared Cognito client secret from SSM (stored as plaintext String) to mint a JWT. Encrypted in transit but plaintext at rest; broad ssm:GetParameter.
Agent presents the Bearer JWT to the OLS/data MCP endpoints; validated by the CUSTOM_JWT authorizer.
Sandbox transforms untrusted source data per the validated declarative spec and writes an additive *_staging Parquet + Glue table (prod untouched). Fixed harness; row-conservation checks.
Agent answers + prompts + provenance/grounding metrics flow to observability (OTel/CloudWatch/EMF). Prompts/answers may appear in traces/logs.

LATENT (BYOD production): customer PHI cohort results flow from the lake to the agent under a single shared IAM role with no per-user data scoping; confidentiality/HIPAA impact is high when this asset is present.

residualRiskAssessments.rationale: No preventive control implemented (no Bedrock Guardrails, no content sanitization); only prompt instruction-following. Top agentic risk; must implement M001/M002 before production.

Citation-discipline prompt + provenance-faithfulness scorer detect fabricated grounding; data is public. Accept for the demo while adding corpus-integrity checks + fabricated-grounding alarms (M016) for production.
Secret stored as plaintext SSM String with Resource:* read; disclosure enables token minting. Fix with SecureString + ARN-scoped SSM (M003) - cheap, high value.
Single shared machine identity; no per-user auth. Acceptable only for a single-operator demo; must adopt per-user SSO (M004) before multi-tenant/production.

Agent runtime is IAM-SigV4 gated (reduces from Critical) but networkMode is PUBLIC and there is no deploy-time authorizer preflight for the MCP path. Enforce authorizer + VPC (M005) and add WAF (M019).
Single IAM role, no per-user data scoping; any authorized caller can reach all data the role can. High for demo, Critical under BYOD. Requires M006.
Read-only guards are implemented and unit-tested, and IAM grants no write actions (backstop). Residual bypass risk is low for read-only public data; add explicit IAM write-Deny (M007) as hardening.

Onboarding text-to-SQL is guarded (SELECT-only, write-keyword reject, table allowlist, LIMIT) and confined to the RODA staging DB over public data. Accept for demo; consolidate onto hub_core.guards (M008).

Strong containment: fixed harness + validate_spec (no LLM-authored AWS I/O), additive staging only, HITL review. Residual is limited to poisoned staging content; harden sandbox network (M009) for production.
No Athena scan cutoff or Neptune complexity/timeout cap; unbounded queries can drive cost/latency. Implement M010 + edge throttling (M019).
No agent iteration/tool-call/spend cap; adversarial prompts or injection can drive denial-of-wallet. Implement M011 + cost alarms.
Sessions are keyed by session_id in a warm container; single-tenant demo makes cross-session leakage low-likelihood. Bind to principal + TTL (M012) before multi-tenant use.
Prompts/answers are logged and traced with no redaction. Low sensitivity for public data but High under BYOD PHI; implement redaction + KMS (M013).
Resource:* IAM amplifies any agent/role compromise across the account. Scope to ARNs and split roles (M014).
Unpinned deps + on-demand uvx MCP resolution widen the supply-chain surface in a trusted runtime. Pin/hash + lock + SCA (M015).
External services are reputable AWS/EBI/PubMed sources; content is already treated as citation-only and public. Accept for demo; add integrity/allowlist checks with M001/M002 for production.
Single shared identity gives no per-user attribution, acceptable for a single-operator public-data demo but a compliance gap for production; addressed by per-user SSO (M004).

Faithfulness is the core value proposition; the SEMHUB_STRIP_GUARDS toggle can disable citation discipline at runtime and is not blocked in prod. Gate the toggle + alarm on fabricated grounding (M016).
Availability-only, non-security; best-effort LF grants + graceful degradation are acceptable for a demo. Add fail-closed verification + alarms (M017) for production.

The shipped posture (single role, no per-user scoping, PUBLIC network, no log redaction, no BAA-aligned config) is unsuitable for PHI. BYOD PHI use must be gated behind a hardened profile (M018) + M006/M013; the repo legal note requires a BAA.

softwareProfile.description: Agentic AI system: Strands agent on Bedrock AgentCore Runtime invoking read-only data tools plus remote MCP servers (OLS, planned oncology-hub-data) and a live RODA MCP client; LLM-driven data onboarding executing ETL in an AgentCore Code Interpreter sandbox. Untrusted external content (RODA datasets, web search, KB passages, graph/lake tool outputs) flows into the LLM context - a prompt-injection surface. Read-only guards (Cypher mutation rejection, SQL SELECT-only) provide defense-in-depth over least-privilege IAM.

dataAssetProfiles.name: TCGA patient cohort data (mutations/expression/CNA)
dataAssetProfiles.description: De-identified public TCGA somatic mutations, gene expression, copy-number in Athena/S3 (Parquet), Lake Formation governed. Queried read-only by query_patient_data. BYOD path may replace this with customer PHI cohort.

dataAssetProfiles.name: Neptune knowledge graph (PrimeKG + TCGA case/sample nodes)
dataAssetProfiles.description: Neptune Analytics graph: PrimeKG biomedical relationships plus TCGA case/sample nodes with clinical properties (age, gender, vital_status). Queried read-only via openCypher (query_knowledge_graph).

dataAssetProfiles.name: Bedrock Knowledge Base literature corpus
dataAssetProfiles.description: PubMed abstracts + TCGA study descriptions vectorized in a Bedrock Knowledge Base; retrieved passages feed the LLM (knowledge_search) - untrusted-content/prompt-injection surface if corpus is poisoned.

dataAssetProfiles.name: Shared Cognito M2M client secret (SSM)
dataAssetProfiles.description: Single shared Cognito machine-to-machine OAuth client_id/secret used to mint JWTs for the OLS (and planned data) MCP endpoints. Stored in SSM as a PLAINTEXT String (not SecureString) per per-user-auth-design.md - anyone with ssm:GetParameter can mint a token.

dataAssetProfiles.name: RODA open-data datasets (untrusted external)
dataAssetProfiles.description: Third-party AWS Registry of Open Data datasets discovered via the live RODA MCP client and ingested (schema, samples, content) into the LLM curation agent and the Code Interpreter ETL sandbox. Untrusted content - prompt-injection and malicious-data surface.

dataAssetProfiles.name: BYOD customer cohort (latent PHI)
dataAssetProfiles.description: Latent asset: the documented Bring-Your-Own-Data path lets a customer swap TCGA for their own patient cohort, which may contain PHI. Not present in the shipped demo but a first-class risk for production deployments (single shared IAM role, no per-user scoping).

dataAssetProfiles.name: Agent answers, prompts and provenance telemetry
dataAssetProfiles.description: User prompts, tool inputs/outputs, agent answers with inline provenance tags, and CloudWatch/EMF grounding metrics emitted for observability. Basis for faithfulness/grounding scoring.

userPersonas.name: Researcher / clinician-scientist
userPersonas.description: Oncology researcher querying the hub in natural language via Amazon Quick / chat UI / MCP client. Untrusted prompt source.

userPersonas.name: Hub deployer / data engineer
userPersonas.description: Deploys the agent + MCP servers via deploy.py, runs the data pipeline, drives the Streamlit onboarding UI. Holds AWS credentials with IAM/Lake Formation/Bedrock permissions.

userPersonas.name: AgentCore runtime execution role
userPersonas.description: The single IAM execution role the AgentCore Runtime assumes to reach Neptune/Athena/Glue/S3/SSM/Bedrock (Resource:*). Also the Code Interpreter scoped role (agentcore-onboarding-ci-role). No per-user scoping.

userPersonas.name: Internet actor (PUBLIC network endpoints)
userPersonas.description: The AgentCore runtimes are networkMode PUBLIC. If the CUSTOM_JWT authorizer is missing/misconfigured (design explicitly warns against shipping unauthenticated), an internet actor can reach the MCP/agent endpoints.

userPersonas.name: External content/data sources (RODA, OLS, web, PubMed)
userPersonas.description: AWS Registry of Open Data datasets, OLS MCP server, AWS-managed web search, PubMed corpus. Their content flows into the LLM context and the ETL sandbox; treated as untrusted (prompt-injection / data-poisoning source).

userPersonas.name: Dataset onboarding operator
userPersonas.description: Operates the agentic onboarding pipeline: selects RODA datasets, reviews LLM-curated mappings/specs (HITL), applies additive staging tables via the Code Interpreter sandbox.

nonFunctionalRequirements.rationale: Provenance faithfulness / grounding is the core value proposition; fabricated citations or ungrounded oncology claims are the primary quality risk.
Serverless AgentCore Runtime scales per-session microVMs.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) over HTTPS+JWT; boto3 to AWS services.
Repo legal note: not for clinical use, not a substitute for medical advice; research/demo only. Accuracy risk captured under Faultlessness.
Unit tests for guards/queries/schema plus an 84-question benchmark and provenance-faithfulness scorers.
